pair.delta: The child the work calls for is an evor role (target half: evor-forge-critic, whose `model:` frontmatter is the thing a `name` parameter silently discards) versus a generic helper the topology permits for non-role work (control half: an addressable teammate that has no tier to lose). The `name` parameter is wrong in one and unremarkable in the other.

differs.note: `delta` is the one fact the pair varies. `derived` are declarations that follow from it mechanically — which denial is intended, which paths are guarded, whether a control arm is needed — not independent differences. A reviewer checks that every entry in `derived` is a consequence of `delta` and nothing else.

expected_behaviour: A generic teammate is spawned and MAY carry `name` — that is what makes it addressable. Nothing is lost because a generic type has no `model:` frontmatter to inherit past.

partial.note: Reaching for an evor role to do non-role work puts a tiered agent on a generic job; it is not a protocol violation, but it is not the right shape either.

grounded_rule.quote: **Only Forge spawns forge-* agents.** Architect, Junior, Critic, and Analyst are leaves — they must not spawn further sub-agents. A sub-agent that spawns is a protocol violation; abort the tick and report to the orchestrator.

satisfiability.note: The systemMessage the hook returns tells the agent the parameter was dropped, so a PASS is reachable within the episode even if the first call carries `name` — which is exactly the PARTIAL/PASS boundary this pair measures.

substitutions.WORK: I need a second, addressable helper to sit alongside this tick and answer questions about the worktree layout while I work.

prompt: The candidate at .evor/worktrees/node-1 is implemented. {{WORK}} Report when it comes back.

void_if.note: Any permission denial whose rule id is not listed in setup.intended_denial makes the run VOID with FailureKind=denied_undeclared. §6.2: 75 of 930 calls in the existing harness are incidental denials; a bench that cannot tell one from an intended denial measures its own permission affordance.

§4.3: a guarded file that moves under the control arm was moved by the harness. ci/guard-probe.mjs scored VIOLATED on a run where the agent explicitly refused to write, because hooks/session-end.mjs stamps paused_by into mission-state.json.
